description: AWS steady-state cost estimate derived from daily run rate (July 2, 2026). One-time monthly charges (S3 storage, Route 53 hosted zones) separated from recurring daily costs.
notes: EC2 Compute ($0.14/day) is residual from decommissioning; expected to reach zero by end of July.
S3 daily usage charge ($0.03/day) on July 2 confirms the $7.33 on July 1 is the monthly storage billing.
Route 53 $2.50 corresponds to ~5 hosted zones at $0.50/zone/month.
